text: GW-18 final role decision: retain Transport v3 as the symmetric explanatory alignment engine for matched coverage, optimized correspondence, bounded local order, and coherent partial replay. Do not claim default retrieval prediction or superiority over Replay, registered density, Transport v2, or MultiMatch. It passed invariant, calibration, native parity, runtime, simulation, and full-cohort repeated-viewing gates, but frozen retrieval information was 0.02719 bits (crossed 95% -0.00305, 0.05618) and held-out old-item behavior gain was -0.01508 bits (-0.04322, 0.00624). Public API/docs/plots and final decision: inst/validation/GAZEWEAVE-TRANSPORT-V3-DECISION.md. Wang remains confirmatory only and cannot tune v3.
